episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Lina's impulsive encounter with a stranger becomes a terrifying trap when she discovers her secret is about to be exposed.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Lina races against the clock to uncover the voyeur, and is shocked to learn that they may be closer than she imagined.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: In the wake of a tragic loss, Lina suspects a darker truth lies within her inner circle.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Months later, Lina enjoys a new relationship, but an innocuous encounter reveals the past isn't as buried as she hoped.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Lina faces the consequences of uncovering the truth and finds herself in an intense psychological mind game with life and death stakes.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: With her life in ashes, Lina closes in on the insidious voyeur responsible for all her suffering, intent on bringing them to justice no matter the cost.
